trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no shortcut: the platinum unlocks the moment the last of the other 54 pops. Work the roadmap in order, story first, then activities and collectibles, and save the 100% completion trophy for last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission and it teaches the basics. Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play the story missions in order until the chapter closes. The trophy pops when the final mission of Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: finish every story mission in Chapter 2 in order and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play the story missions in order until the chapter closes; the trophy pops at the end of its final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the last story mission of the game. Finish it and the trophy pops at the end. If you are hunting the platinum, do the missable trophies before this point, because the story ends here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow the objectives to the end; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a heist mission, so follow the plan the game lays out and finish it to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the objectives to the end; the trophy pops at mission complete.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the objectives to the end; the trophy pops at mission complete.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. Follow the objectives to the end; the trophy pops at mission complete.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the objectives to the end; the trophy pops at mission complete.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. This is the completionist trophy: finish the story, all side missions, all activities and all collectibles. Use this checklist to track what is left, and check the in-game stats page for your completion percentage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps and stunt challenges count toward the total, which is tracked in the in-game stats menu. Pick a fast car and a repeatable jump and grind it; the count carries across the whole game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample every activity the game offers at least once: a race, the shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, and the rest. You do not need to win, just try each one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Go to the shooting range and work through every challenge. Gold medals need accuracy and speed, so use a steady weapon, aim for the high-value targets first, and reload between rounds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each Top Fun drone race spot, enter, and win. Learn each course line before you race for the win; a practice run saves a failed attempt.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Only distinct races count, so repeats of the same race do not add to the total. Mix race types and locations until you have 20 wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and challenge him to a fishing contest. Out-fish him by keeping your line tension in the safe zone and reeling steadily; do not let the line snap.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade and finish a full game to its end, whatever the game is.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Find stranger missions around the map and finish 8 full strands. They are marked on the map when you get close, so explore each region.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy pops when that mission ends.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find every meditation spot on the map and meditate at each one. The spots are scenic viewpoints; the map marks them once discovered, so check the regions you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take the hunting work from Bret, track the unique animal he names, and take it down. Bring a scoped rifle, approach quietly, and watch the wind.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards hidden around Leonida and finish 3 complete sets. Cards are tucked into shops, houses and landmarks; check the community card map (PSNProfiles) for the ones you are missing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots across the map. The count is tracked in stats; spread it across regions so you do not miss the remote spots.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenge list and finish 50 of them. The challenge menu shows your progress and what each one asks for, so pick the easy ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. It only counts with your partner present. Missable: it needs a partner moment, so do it while partner missions are available.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping the wanted level active. Move fast between shops and do not let the cops drop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles. The count tracks distinct models, so try every class, from bikes to trucks to boats, and check the stats menu for what you still need.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with 5 enemies in front of you and drop all 5 before it ends. A mission with a room full of enemies is the easiest place to line it up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, get into a plane and take off without a scheduled flight. This reads like a one-time moment, so treat it as missable and do it the first time the chance appears. Exact trigger unconfirmed: check the community guides (PSNProfiles, Exophase) for the precise setup.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino tank and use it. The exact trigger is not confirmed from the official description alone, so check the community guides (Exophase, PSNProfiles) for the precise requirement before you go hunting for one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out without tripping an alarm or being spotted. Go at night, move quietly, take the goods and leave before the alarm sounds.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan the escape route before you go in, and keep a fast car nearby.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and escape the wanted level. Block it with your car, then drive off fast.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region and area of the map. The map fills in as you go; check the regions list in stats to see what is left, then drive there.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for every gang in the game. Each gang's operations sit in their own territory, so work through the map gang by gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It pops when the drink is served with the ocean in front of you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the glass. The classic GTA move.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague; it reads like a partner-activity milestone. The exact trigger is not confirmed from the official description alone, so check the community guides (Exophase, PSNProfiles) before chasing it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This is a story-choice trophy: it pops for a specific decision in the story. Because a choice can lock you out of the other branch, treat it as missable and check the choice guide (PowerPyx, PSNProfiles) before the decision point, so you pick the branch you want.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name suggests failing once and succeeding on the retry of a specific moment. The exact trigger is not confirmed from the official description alone, so check the community guides before the moment passes. Treat it as missable.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This reads like a one-time strange event or easter egg. The exact trigger is not confirmed from the official description alone, so check the community guides (Exophase, PSNProfiles) for where and when it happens, and do it before it passes. Treat it as missable.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The name points at bowling pins: knock the pins down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact setup is not confirmed from the official description alone, so check the community guides for the precise method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until you have earned $250,000 from it. It accumulates across the game, so keep laundering as you earn.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 total in shops of any kind. It accumulates, and expensive cars and clothes get you there fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property the game offers. The property menu lists them; save up and buy them all.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 vehicles to it. Any vehicles you own count once registered.
